models: cached faster-whisper-base.en and medium.en; CPU int8; English; independent text recognition without source prompt
normalization: Case/punctuation, numeric notation and hull ID spacing, common contractions, center/centre, under cover/undercover, Transocean spacing, gimbaled/gimballed. Raw transcripts retained. No phonetic name aliases or dropped words are excused.
scope: Recognized word sequence only; not proof of correct pronunciation, prosody or absence of clicks.
